description: Source code for the ModuleScanner class in SuiteCRM, responsible for scanning modules, checking for security issues, and handling manifest files.

classes.name: ModuleScanner
classes.description: Class for scanning module files, checking for security issues, and processing manifest files in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: printToWiki
methods.description: Outputs default extensions and blacklisted functions in wiki format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the scanner, merging global and constant configurations.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Returns the list of issues found during scanning.

methods.name: hasIssues
methods.description: Returns true if any issues have been detected.

methods.name: isValidExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file has a valid extension based on configured list.

methods.name: isConfigFile
methods.description: Determines if a file is a core configuration file.

methods.name: scanDir
methods.description: Recursively scans a directory for files to analyze.

methods.name: isPHPFile
methods.description: Checks if file contents appear to be PHP code.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Analyzes a file for security issues, including blacklisted functions and patterns.

methods.name: sugarFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the SugarCRM files.md5 list, indicating it is a core file.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path, removing dots and multiple slashes.

methods.name: scanManifest
methods.description: Scans a manifest file for disabled actions and file overrides.

methods.name: scanCopy
methods.description: Checks if copying a file would override core SugarCRM files.

methods.name: scanPackage
methods.description: Main function to scan a module package, including its manifest and files.

methods.name: displayIssues
methods.description: Displays detected issues in a human-readable format.

methods.name: getIssuesLog
methods.description: Returns issues as an HTML-formatted string.

methods.name: lockConfig
methods.description: Locks the current configuration state to detect modifications.

methods.name: checkConfig
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has been modified since locking.
